Class TurRagUtils

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.TurRagUtils
public final class TurRagUtils extends Object
Shared utility methods for RAG operations (HTML sanitization, semantic chunking, document creation). Used by both SN GenAI and Asset Training pipelines.

Indexing pipeline:

  1. stripHtml(String) — when the source attribute contains markup, tags are removed and whitespace is normalized so that embeddings reflect semantic content, not HTML structure.
  2. splitText(String, int) — splits the cleaned text by paragraph → sentence → word boundaries, never cutting words mid-string. Adjacent chunks share a small overlap to preserve context across boundaries.
Since:
2026.1.14

  • Method Details

    • stripHtml

      public static String stripHtml(String text)
      Strips HTML markup from text when it looks like HTML, decoding entities and normalizing whitespace. Block-level elements (p, div, li, h1–h6, br, …) become paragraph breaks (\n\n) so the chunker can split along semantic boundaries afterwards.

      Returns the original input unchanged when no markup is detected, so plain-text fields incur no overhead.

    • normalizeWhitespace

      public static String normalizeWhitespace(String text)
      Collapses runs of spaces/tabs to a single space and runs of 3+ newlines to two, while preserving paragraph breaks (\n\n).

    • splitText

      public static List<String> splitText(String text, int chunkSize)
      Splits text into chunks no larger than chunkSize characters, respecting paragraph and sentence boundaries. Falls back to word-aware splitting only when a single sentence is itself longer than the chunk size — words are never cut in the middle. Adjacent paragraph/sentence units are packed together as long as the total stays under chunkSize; otherwise each unit gets its own chunk so that paragraph-level context is preserved end-to-end.

    • createDocumentsWithHeader

      public static List<org.springframework.ai.document.Document> createDocumentsWithHeader(String header, String body, int chunkSize, Map<String,Object> metadata)
      Splits body into chunks and prepends header to each chunk — "contextual chunk header" / header propagation pattern. Every chunk becomes self-contained: a downstream embedding/LLM sees the document's identity (title, category, instructor, …) regardless of which chunk was retrieved, eliminating the orphan-chunk problem ("## Title" alone in one chunk and the value in another) and reducing false adjacency between unrelated fields.

      If header is blank, behaves exactly like createDocuments(String, int, Map). If body is blank, the header alone becomes a single chunk so the document is still findable by its identity.

      Parameters:
      header - the contextual block to prepend to every chunk (e.g. "# Title\nCategory: Foo\n..."). Already HTML-stripped and normalized.
      body - the long-form content to chunk (already HTML-stripped).
      chunkSize - maximum characters per chunk (header counted in).
      metadata - metadata propagated to every produced Document.

    • createDocumentsWithHeader

      public static List<org.springframework.ai.document.Document> createDocumentsWithHeader(String header, String body, int chunkSize, Map<String,Object> metadata, String idPrefix)
      Same as createDocumentsWithHeader(String, String, int, Map) but assigns deterministic Document.id values of the form {idPrefix}-{chunkIndex} (e.g. "doc-1-0", "doc-1-1"). This lets the underlying vector store dedupe by id on re-index — the Lucene store, for example, calls IndexWriter.updateDocument(new Term("id", chunkId), ...) which atomically replaces the prior chunk with the same id, so reindexing the same source content does not duplicate embeddings.

      Pass null or blank to fall back to Spring AI's default UUID-based ids (the prior behavior).

      Since:
      2026.2.4
